name: roamgate
description: Roamgate: an independent community Web and PWA client for Herdr.
author: Arthur

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:linux-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:darwin-x64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:darwin-arm64
scripts.build:windows-x64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:windows-x64
scripts.build:windows-arm64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:windows-arm64
scripts.build:all: bun run build:web && bun run --filter roamgate-server compile:all
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter roamgate-web typecheck && bun run --filter roamgate-server typecheck
scripts.precommit: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.clean: rm -rf web/dist server/public server/src/public-files.gen.ts server/roamgate server/roamgate.exe server/roamgate-* server/herdr-gui server/herdr-gui-* && bun run clean:bun-build
